<thought>Based on the mass spectrum (M⁺ = 114.068 Da) the molecular formula is C₆H₁₀O₂. The ¹³C NMR shows a carbonyl (~168 ppm), two sp² carbons (~144 and 130 ppm) and three methyl groups (~22, 21, 19 ppm), consistent with an α‑β unsaturated ester bearing an ethyl group. The structure that fits these data is ethyl methacrylate, whose SMILES is C=C(C)C(=O)OCC.</thought>
<final_answer>C=C(C)C(=O)OCC</final_answer>
